summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, as a foreign private issuer under SEC Rule 13a-16, providing a routine operational update on its average daily Time Charter Equivalent (TCE) rates for Q2 2026. The filing discloses TCE rates across LR2, MR, and Handymax vessel classes, along with expected revenue days and coverage percentages, and an estimate of fully diluted weighted average shares outstanding. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return is addressed; the report is a standard periodic operating update with no transaction, tender offer, or strategic change.
